title: Abelian etale sheaves on a finite clopen coproduct decompose componentwise
statement: Let $C=\coprod_{i\in I}C_i$ be a finite coproduct of schemes [lem-weil-pbc-scheme-coproduct-family], with coprojections $\iota_i:C_i\hookrightarrow C$ open and closed. Restriction along the $\iota_i$ identifies the category of abelian sheaves on $C_{\mathrm{Et}}$ [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves] with the finite product of the categories of abelian sheaves on $(C_i)_{\mathrm{Et}}$: a sheaf $F$ is recovered from the family $(\iota_i^{-1}F)_{i\in I}$ [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image], and morphisms are recovered componentwise. Under this identification, the global-sections functor $F\mapsto F(C)$ is the finite product of the component global-sections functors $G_i\mapsto G_i(C_i)$.

proof.text: In the abelian sheaf categories [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], let R be Functor.pi' of the component upperStar functors and let S be Functor.pi of the component lowerStar functors followed by Pi.functor I. Construct the natural transformation eta: id -> R S by Pi.lift of the units of Etale.upperStarLowerStarAdjunction. Construct epsilon: S R -> id componentwise by upperStar.map of the product projection followed by the counit of that same adjunction. Their naturality follows from Pi.lift_π, Pi.map_π and adjunction naturality.

proof.text: Prove eta invertible by the helper iso_of_component_iso: apply Sheaf.isIso_of_coversTop to the coprojection cover, compare upperStar with openImmersionRestriction using Etale.upperStarIsoLocalizationRestriction [lem-weil-pbc-etale-inverse-image-restriction], and identify the over-site evaluations directly by MorphismProperty.Over.isoMk; sheafToPresheaf reflects isomorphisms. For fixed i, all upperStar_i(lowerStar_j(G_j)) with j != i are zero by Etale.isZero_openImmersionRestriction_lowerStar and the restriction comparison. The proved helper single_product_projection therefore makes the i-th product projection invertible. upperStar_i preserves these products, so piComparison_comp_π makes the pulled-back projection invertible. Its composite with upperStar_i.map eta is the pulled-back adjunction unit, invertible by Etale.isIso_upperStar_map_upperStarLowerStarAdjunction_unit_of_isOpenImmersion and fully faithful open-immersion pushforward [lem-sc-open-immersion-pushforward-fully-faithful]. NatIso.isIso_of_isIso_app yields id ~= R S.

proof.text: For epsilon, the same disjointness, cross-component vanishing, restriction comparison, single_product_projection and product-preservation argument makes upperStar_i.map of the i-th projection invertible. The counit of upperStar_i / lowerStar_i is invertible because lowerStar_i is fully faithful for an open immersion [lem-sc-open-immersion-pushforward-fully-faithful]. Thus every component of epsilon is invertible, hence S R ~= id by componentwise inverses and NatIso.isIso_of_isIso_app. CategoryTheory.Equivalence.mk R S eta epsilon gives R.IsEquivalence.

proof.text: Let Gamma and Gamma_i be the global-sections functors, evaluated at Scheme.Etale.mk of the identity. Etale.lowerStarCompSheafSectionsTerminalIso, transported from the chosen terminal objects with terminalIsoIsTerminal, gives lowerStar_i followed by Gamma ~= Gamma_i. Gamma preserves products because sheafToPresheaf and evaluation preserve limits. PreservesProduct.iso and Pi.mapIso consequently give S followed by Gamma ~= Functor.pi Gamma_i followed by Pi.functor I; naturality follows by Pi.hom_ext, piComparison_comp_π_assoc and the component comparison naturality. Whisker the reconstruction unit iso by Gamma and compose these comparisons using Functor.leftUnitor and Functor.associator to obtain the asserted global-sections iso.
